name: Madhu Jaiswal

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Madhu Jaiswal is a bilingual poet and editor from Kolkata. Her poems have appeared in literary journals including Setu, and her editorial work has included anthologies with The Impish Lass Publishing House. In her contributor biography, she describes writing as a way to attend to the inner life, alongside a commitment to compassion and social service.

‘Damsel’, her Kabita Live contribution, tests the distance between a woman’s authority at work and her place at home. The admired professional returns to an unequal burden of household labour, with little room for her own voice. The poem’s plain, insistent account ends with continuing effort rather than resolution, keeping the reader’s attention on the support she is denied.
